label: Trade War Room: the normal Send button now closes the in-app staging bypass -- if the league has cut over to staged offers, Send itself automatically holds your offer server-side (same popup, same review, no separate button to remember) instead of sending it to MFL directly, and the old direct-send endpoint refuses new offers server-side too, so a stale or cached app can't slip around it. Two-team offers can be staged instead of sent straight to MFL -- held server-side for the other owner to review and accept, so a roster change between offer and acceptance can never sneak a trade through. Before sending or staging a two-team or three-team offer, a popup shows the projected loaded-contract count for BOTH affected teams (not just your own), with each affected owner picking only their own conditional drops. A new Staged Trades list and detail view (Accept, Decline, Cancel, Re-check) works the same on mobile and desktop.
